title: BodyPerfect service directory
text:
The BodyPerfect services directory lists these 12 service categories. These are website labels, not claims of proven benefit or promised results:
- Weightloss & Slimming
- Beauty & Aesthetics
- Pain Management
- Ayurveda
- Gut & DNA
- Regenerative
- IV Therapy
- Longevity
- Reverse Lifestyle Diseases
- Personal Training
- Dr. Jaison’s ABB Diet Plan
- Dr. Jaison’s “20 KGs in 60 Days” Transformation Program
For clinical suitability, risks, realistic goals, prices and availability, request a clinic consultation. Do not interpret program titles as achievable or guaranteed outcomes.
